name: node_remote
description: Remote command surface for the Logos blockchain node, served over a Tor v3 onion service with client authorization.
//dependencies: INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. blockchain_module does NOT ship a generated SDK header (verified: no blockchain_module_api.h anywhere in /nix/store, while delivery/storage/chat/capability/radio all do). Listing it here makes logos-cpp-generator emit `#include "blockchain_module_api.h"` into logos_sdk.h and the build dies with a fatal error that points at logos_sdk.h rather than at this file. See skill metadata-json-deps-sdk-codegen. Node state is read from the node's own REST API instead — which is what logos-blockchain-ui and logos-node-basecamp/NodePlugin both actually do. Start/stop (E2) needs blockchain_module.start/stop via untyped invokeRemoteMethod, not a typed dep.

find_packages: Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Network HttpServer
